Paragraph: As the war ended, Kunti stood upon the crimson soil of Kurukshetra alongside the surviving Pandavas to perform the funeral rites for the fallen. Looking upon the slain Karna, her heart broke under the unbearable weight of a lifetime of silence. Weeping uncontrollably, she surrendered to her long-suppressed sorrow and confessed the truth to Yudhishthira: 'Offer water for Karna, O my son. He was your eldest brother, born to me by Surya, the Sun God, before my marriage. The heroic warrior whom you fought with such fierce enmity was your own blood, discarded by me out of fear of social disgrace.' Hearing this, Yudhishthira trembled with profound shock and anguish, realizing that their bitterest foe was their eldest brother, while Kunti stood overwhelmed by devastating grief and late, agonizing regret.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Kunti faces the overwhelming psychological burden of a lifelong secret, experiencing unbearable maternal guilt and grief after realizing her discarded firstborn, Karna, has been killed by his own brothers.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Driven by severe emotional distress and grief, Kunti finally confesses the truth of Karna's birth to the Pandavas, breaking decades of silence and confronting the tragic consequence of her secret.
Outcome/Resolution: The revelation plunges Yudhishthira into deep despair and survivor's guilt, prompting him to curse all womankind to be unable to keep secrets, while Kunti is left to live with the irreversible tragedy of her choices.

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Kunti's tragedy illustrates the inescapable law of Karma and the destructive nature of secrets kept out of fear (Lajja-Bhaya). Her belated repentance (Anutapa) comes after the damage is irreversible, demonstrating how social fear can lead to severe spiritual and familial catastrophe.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: This passage provides a profound case study of long-term trauma concealment, shame-driven secrecy, and acute delayed grief. Kunti exhibits severe emotional breakdown when the psychological defense mechanisms holding her secret fail, releasing decades of suppressed guilt and causing profound secondary trauma to her surviving sons.
